parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description:
The file system ID.

- CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-099394bd928c****.

- CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of results per query.
Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 10.
